strategy_roster.name: SuperTrend Enhanced Pivot Reversal
strategy_roster.notes: A prior ten-bar high break stands in for a formed pivot, while bearish EMA(20/50) alignment approximates bearish SuperTrend; their inverse exits. ATR SuperTrend, exact left/right pivot bars, and factor 2.618 are unavailable; 20% is the documented pivot stop.

strategy_roster.name: Traffic Light
strategy_roster.entry_long: close >= sma(close,120) and close <= sma(close,55) and ema(close,5) > ema(close,24) > sma(close,55) > sma(close,120) and close > ema(close,5)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented red SMA(120), yellow SMA(55), green EMA(5), and blue EMA(24) ordering and default entry zone are retained for the long side. The optional blue-range filter is disabled by default; 60/120-tick protection and the intraday timeframe are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Crossover
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9) crossovers and the documented -0.5 to 0.5 entry zone are translated directly. No stops are documented, and the intraday timeframe is supplied by the roster consumer rather than an indicator expression.

strategy_roster.name: AML CCI Meeting Lines
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and close - open >= 0.5 * atr(high,low,close,14) and rsi(close,18) <= 40
strategy_roster.notes: A large bullish candle plus RSI(18)<=40 proxies the documented Meeting Lines and CCI<=-50 vote; RSI>=80 proxies the extreme exit. The two-candle equal-close test and body-average period 3 cannot be recovered without shifted OHLC, and no percentage protection is supplied.

strategy_roster.name: Color XTRIX Histogram
strategy_roster.notes: A smoothed MACD line using the documented TRIX length 5 approximates its zero-crossing histogram turns; 5/20/5 are explicit fallbacks because the underlying smoothing formula is unavailable. No stops are documented, and the 4-hour timeframe is not encoded in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Clouds Trade 2
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) downward and upward crosses through 20/80 are an explicit Stochastic %K/%D proxy for the long-side branch. Williams fractals, one-trade-per-day timing, and absolute-price stop/target/trailing settings are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: OBV ATR
strategy_roster.notes: volume_ratio(30) and its prior 30-value Donchian boundaries are a stateless proxy for OBV channel breaks using the documented lookback. Exact cumulative OBV/ATR state and the unspecified protective-order distances cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: FineTuning MA Candle Duplex
strategy_roster.notes: Positive ten-bar momentum plus a bullish candle is a fallback proxy for the synthetic FineTuningMA bullish stream; EMA(10) is used because no length is supplied. Rank/shift weights, gap handling, bar offsets, and point-based protection are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Parabolic SAR First Dot
strategy_roster.notes: A fresh two-bar high with bullish EMA(5/20) alignment proxies the first Parabolic SAR dot below price; EMA(20) loss is the opposite flip. SAR acceleration settings and 900/200-point protection are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Aver4 Stoch Post ZigZag
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close,14) < 5 and low < donchian_low_prev(low,14) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) below the documented 5 level and a new 14-bar low that closes bullish proxy oversold Stochastic plus a ZigZag low. Four timeframe averages, depth 14 pivot confirmation, and intraday timing are approximated; StartProtection is explicitly 2%/2%.
